comment: Resolution-dependent sites of Sacred.exe for an opt-in screen size (tools/lift/resolution.py). Addresses are instruction starts (code) or data addresses; length is the instruction/data length in bytes (the bytes are read from the player's executable); value is an expression in W and H (and hd(on, off) for layout changes that only apply with the mode on) that gives the original value at 1024x768. Group 1: world projection and screen centre, world culling bounds, screen-sized surfaces and the render list buffers.
